subject: Geo-routing & deletion procedure integration Q&A
messages:
From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@cloudside.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Geo-routing & deletion procedure integration Q&A

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Before we move to procurement I need a few clarifications so our legal and cloud ops teams can sign off on the marketplace listing. High level asks below:

1) For customers selecting region (US / EU / APAC) at purchase, can you confirm Redwood will guarantee storage and persistent logs remain in the selected cloud region (AWS us-west-2 / GCP us-central1 / Azure eastus) and not be replicated to other regions for processing?

2) Deletion flow: when a customer requests account deletion, what is the timeline for deleting S3/GCS/Azure Blob objects, model KV caches, and audit logs? Is deletion irreversible and propagated to backups?

3) Retention policy mapping — we need a simple table we can show to CloudSide legal that maps our UI selection to the underlying retention periods and what is considered "deleted" vs "archived".

4) Proof-of-deletion / audit: can Redwood provide a time-stamped event and an exportable report (CSV or signed PDF) that CloudSide can upload into their compliance tracker?

We attached our internal requirements doc (CloudSide_data-handshake_requirements.pdf). Please loop in whatever teams are needed.

Thanks,

Priya Mehta
Head of Integrations, CloudSide
priya.mehta@cloudside.ai
+1-415-555-0199

Attachments: CloudSide_data-handshake_requirements.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@cloudside.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Geo-routing & deletion procedure integration Q&A

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. Looping in Laura (legal) and Grace (solutions) so we can give you a consolidated answer and a short implementation plan you can attach to the marketplace listing. Quick bullets to set context:

- We support region-scoped storage for marketplace customers. Customers picking a region are placed on a tenant that has data egress routed and stored in that region.
- Deletion is multi-layered: application-level record removal, object storage deletion, and background garbage collection for KV caches; backup retention depends on the backup SLA (we document this).
- We can produce time-stamped deletion events and a CSV export for audit purposes.

Laura / Grace — can you review Priya's attached doc and the three asks below and confirm the exact SLA language and an ops playbook (one-page) that details timings and proof artifacts? I sketched a proposed timeline below but want your sign-off before sending to CloudSide legal.

Proposed simple timeline (draft):
- Initiate deletion: 0–1 business day after request (remove account access, mark records for deletion)
- Storage objects & KV caches: 1–7 business days (dependent on object count & queued batches)
- Backups snapshot retention: retained per backup policy, with request-based expedited purge (up to 30 days for final purge)
- Proof-of-deletion: timestamped event + CSV export within 5 business days after final purge

Priya — once we have Laura/Grace sign-off I can send a short technical appendix and a DocuSign-ready clause for your legal team.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@cloudside.ai>
Date: 2028-06-07T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Geo-routing & deletion procedure integration Q&A

Marcus / Priya —

Thanks for the summary. From a legal/contracting perspective we can commit to region-scoped storage and to providing deletion attestations, but need to be precise on backup purge language. Two items:

1) We will state in the SOW/contract: "Customer data will be stored in the selected cloud region and will not be intentionally replicated to other regions except for operational failover; Redwood will notify Customer if failover replication is performed." That covers emergency/DR exceptions.

2) Backup purge: we cannot guarantee instantaneous permanent removal of data from immutable backups. We will commit to an expedited purge request process: upon verified customer deletion request Redwood will initiate backup deletion and provide an estimated window (typically up to 30 days) and a signed proof-of-deletion report when the purge completes.

Action for Marcus: please ask Grace to detail the technical steps and any controls CloudSide must exercise (e.g., blocking new writes, confirming retention period choices in UI) so we can bake that into the DocuSign clause.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@cloudside.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Geo-routing & deletion procedure integration Q&A

Hi Priya —

Thanks — attached is a short ops playbook and a diagram showing how customer selection maps to region, buckets, and routing (redwood-geo-routing-diagram.png). Key technical notes below:

- Region binding: when a customer completes marketplace purchase we provision a region-scoped tenant and tag all storage buckets and compute nodes with that region ID. Data-in-transit may traverse other regions for routing but persistent storage is pinned.
- Deletion flow:
  * Step 1 (0–24 hrs): mark account "deleting", revoke runtime keys, block new writes.
  * Step 2 (1–7 days): background workers delete object storage objects in batches; KV caches cleared immediately on mark. We use multi-pass deletes to handle eventual consistency on object stores.
  * Step 3 (up to 30 days): initiate backup purge request; timeline depends on third-party snapshot cadence.
- Proof artifacts: system generates a signed CSV with the following columns: resource_id, resource_type, region, deleted_at, deletion_operation_id. We can also provide a PDF with a timestamped signature if CloudSide prefers.

Notes/limitations:
- For extremely large customers with petabyte datasets we may recommend a two-step approach (bulk export + customer-side scrub) to avoid prolonged delete windows.
- If the marketplace listing requires stricter backup purging (e.g., <7 days) we can discuss a paid expedited purge SLA and the engineering changes needed to meet that.

Attachments: redwood-geo-routing-diagram.png, retention-deletion-table.csv

Happy to set a 30-minute ops call to walk through the steps with CloudSide infra.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
